parameters.name: DeviceSpeechList
parameters.description: The list of speech corpus to delete.

sub_parameters.name: AudioFormat
sub_parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

sub_parameters.name: BizCode
sub_parameters.description: The identifier of the speech corpus. You can call [QuerySpeech](~~217577~~) to query the speech corpus identifier.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description: The ID that IoT Platform assigns to the device. This is the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~) to query the device ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
